record.question: She speaks so slowly that I cannot hear her.
record.explanation: Answer C: Adverb clause. “That I cannot hear her” gives the result of speaking so slowly; adverb clause. Independent check: “That I cannot hear her” gives the result of speaking so slowly; it is an adverbial result clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/so-such. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Directions (Question 28 to 35): Identify the kind of the subordinate clause in the given sentences.
